description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractIndexer' within the 'SuiteCRM\Search\Index' namespace. It provides a base implementation for a search indexer component, including methods for indexing modules, beans, and managing indexing configurations, as well as logging facilities. The class is intended to be extended by concrete indexer implementations in the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: AbstractIndexer
classes.description: An abstract base class for search indexers that manages common functionality such as module management, bean indexing, logging setup, and document conversion configuration.

methods.name: getIndexerName
methods.description: Returns the short class name of the current indexer instance.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the indexing of the entire database; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Abstract method to index a single module; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Abstract method to index a single SugarBean; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Abstract method to index multiple SugarBeans in a module; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a specific bean from the index.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Abstract method to remove multiple beans from the index.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to delete the entire index.

methods.name: isDifferentialIndexing
methods.description: Checks if differential indexing mode is enabled.

methods.name: setDifferentialIndexing
methods.description: Enables or disables differential indexing mode.

methods.name: getDocumentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the current documentifier instance used for converting beans.

methods.name: setDocumentifier
methods.description: Sets a specific documentifier for converting beans.

methods.name: getDocumentifierName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the current documentifier.

methods.name: getModulesToIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules scheduled for indexing.

methods.name: setModulesToIndex
methods.description: Overrides the modules to be indexed in future runs.

methods.name: addModulesToIndex
methods.description: Adds one or more modules to the list of modules to index.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the Monolog Logger instance used for logging.

methods.name: setupLogger
methods.description: Initializes and configures the internal Logger with handlers.

methods.name: getObjectClassName
methods.description: Utility method to get the short class name of an object via reflection.
